answer: Every identity's funding is traced to a root source; identities sharing a root form a cluster, and each cluster posts a bond of 20 credits per member that is burned if the cluster's miss rate exceeds 10 percent. A sybil farm of 1,000 clones drawn from one treasury is a single cluster posting 20,000 credits at risk every epoch, while 1,000 honest agents funded separately form no cluster and post nothing. The vault then reads the echo of a thousand accounts as one coordinated actor, and every ember of fraud costs the operator a slice of its own collateral.
